name: tania
description: TANIA — Telkom AI Native Intelligent Assistant / AI Employee for Digital Product & Solution

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @tania/types && npm run build --workspace @tania/config && npm run build --workspace @tania/core
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace @tania/api && npm run build --workspace @tania/runtime && npm run build --workspace @tania/web
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:packages && npm run test:e2e --workspace @tania/api
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.test:interop: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @tania/runtime && npm run test:interop --workspace @tania/web
